headline: Benchmarks and audits are testing ML models across molecular and microbiome data
label: Ml Benchmarking For Biological Data
summary: Standardized public benchmarks, simulators and leaderboard audits address reproducibility and data leakage in ML models for biological data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is evaluation infrastructure for machine learning on biological and chemical data. FlexMS standardizes MS/MS spectrum prediction across molecular encoders, metadata conditioning and retrieval using public data. GlycoForge simulates comparative glycomics data with known ground truth, motif-level effects, batch effects and missing data for method benchmarking. An audit of TDC ADMET leaderboard models examines reproducibility, data leakage and test-set overfitting, with only 3 of top models passing all checks. A community blind challenge reports outcomes for SARS-CoV-2 and MERS-CoV Mpro potency and pose prediction, and ChemTorch provides OOD splitters for reaction property benchmarking. PhyMapNet and ABaCo contribute methods: phylogeny-aware Bayesian network inference and adversarial correction of batch effects for metagenomic integration. The shared emphasis is testing models against known truth or independent audit.
